shortDescription: Manages a DNS resource record in an authoritative zone.

options.name: comment
options.description: The description for the DNS resource record. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: configure_record_protection
options.description: Protection level for the DNS resource record. When set, configures protected access for the created or updated record. Use 'None' to remove protection from a record.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Indicates if the DNS resource record is disabled. A disabled object is effectively non-existent when generating configuration. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: inheritance_sources
options.description: The inheritance configuration of the Record.

options.name: name_in_zone
options.description: The relative owner name to the zone origin. Must be specified for creating the DNS resource record and is read only for other operations.

options.name: options
options.description: The DNS resource record type-specific non-protocol options.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: rdata
options.description: The DNS resource record data in JSON format. Certain DNS resource record-specific subfields are required for creating the DNS resource record.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags for the DNS resource record in JSON format.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The record time to live value in seconds. The range of this value is 0 to 2147483647. Defaults to TTL value from the SOA record of the zone.

options.name: type
options.description: The DNS resource record type specified in the textual mnemonic format or in the "TYPEnnn" format where "nnn" indicates the numeric type value. V(Value      | Numeric Type  |   Description) V(A          |       1       |   Address record) V(AAAA       |      28       |   IPv6 Address record) V(CAA        |     257       |   Certification Authority Authorization record) V(CNAME      |       5       |   Canonical Name record) V(DNAME      |      39       |   Delegation Name record) V(DHCID      |
